title: hoop/feedback@0: a review of a document

review_id.description: The review this feedback is on

revision.description: The revision it was given on

verdict.description: The reviewer's verdict. A person's review is "approved" or "changes_requested", on the review page; "comment" is a session's own comment, a quick question's answer, or a person's review from before hoop offered two verdicts, which asks for changes

summary.description: An overall comment, or an approval's notes

thread.description: The thread a reply belongs to; leave out for a new comment

item.description: The item's ID, or DOC for the title, TL;DR and subtitle

line.description: The line, from 1; 0 is the item's heading, and DOC line 1 is the title, 2 the TL;DR and 3 the subtitle

range.description: The words the comment is about, inside the line

quote.description: The exact text from start to end

suggestion.description: Replacement text for the range, or for the whole line

answers.description: Answers to questions: each question's ID and the chosen option, or the reviewer's own words

choice.description: The chosen option's ID, or "other" for the reviewer's own answer

text.description: The reviewer's own answer, when the choice is "other"

recommended.description: True when the reviewer approved, or pressed Go with your recommendation on a quick question, without picking, and hoop took the agent's recommended option

corrects.description: On a quick question: the earlier answer this one replaces, which the agent had already read

viewed.description: Items the reviewer marked as viewed

reviewer.description: Who gave it, as they named themselves

session.description: The Claude Code session that commented with hoop_comment: its ID and title
